versions.content: The Function Inhibition Manager shall use the FID - DemCom- ponentId - inhibition configuration to determine the permission state for the configured FID. Upon changes of the FAILED status of a DemComponent , the function status shall be recalculated. Whenever the component status is FAILED ( ComponentFailedStatus = TRUE), the FID is inhibited.
